items.title: Does Hlawga's visible fauna field contain only explicitly linked animal records?
assumptions: An animal is retained only when its stored protected-area relationship explicitly names Hlawga Wildlife Park or လှော်ကား ဥယျာဥ်.
Generic fauna labels and species identifiers without that explicit animal-to-Hlawga relationship are removed from the visible fauna fields.

source.label: Wildlife catalog and animal relationships
filters: Animal relationship fields: protected_areas_my and portal_data.in_protected_area
Visible fauna fields: species_fauna, species_fauna_mm, other_fauna, other_fauna_mm
caveats: The cleanup follows stored explicit relationships and does not infer additional species from descriptive text.
The source record and application database were both updated.

evidenceFlow.title: Explicit relationship match
evidenceFlow.detail: Two animal records explicitly name Hlawga: Jungle Cat (ID 37) and Rhesus Macaque (ID 59).

evidenceFlow.title: Visible-field alignment
evidenceFlow.detail: The source and database now contain the same two linked identifiers and Burmese names; other fauna fields are empty.

evidenceFlow.title: Database integrity
evidenceFlow.detail: All 39 protected-area catalog records remain present and SQLite integrity_check returned ok.
